label: LinkedIn
enables: Posting approved LinkedIn drafts for you, if you turn it on. Later: reading company pages and people you follow while signed in.
connect: Help me connect my brand's LinkedIn account to Fishbowl Studio. Don't ask for my password, don't type it for me and don't store anything: walk me through signing in to linkedin.com myself, in my own browser (the one Claude in Chrome uses), one step at a time, then check with me which account or company page is open. The studio only notes that it's connected.
post_warning: Posting to LinkedIn by automation breaks LinkedIn's User Agreement, and LinkedIn can restrict the account.
